title: spec: declare the AI answer follow-up routes cloud ships (saved questions, turn artifact, turn feedback) and carry turn_id on AIConversation.messages
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Seam: cloud (producer, cloud#4107) → console `plugin-chatbot` (consumer, #31889, #31865)

Filing gate: ④ the contract carrier two retriage asks need. `domain:ui#1` asked on #31889 and #31865 (2026-11-12T06:49Z) for a contract-first carrier ahead of the console halves. Split by triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is missing (reading of origin/main `3452dec21`, by the asking seat)

- No file under `packages/spec/src`, `packages/client*/src` or `ui/packages` names `saved-questions`, a turn `artifact` route or a turn `feedback` route. `grep -rln "saved-questions\|savedQuestion\|saved_question"` has one unrelated hit; `grep -rln "turns/.*feedback\|AnswerFeedback\|answer_feedback"` has none.
- The request and response shapes of `/api/v1/ai/saved-questions`, `…/turns/:turnId/artifact` and `…/turns/:turnId/feedback` live only in cloud (cloud#4107). A console dev would have to guess them.
- `AIConversation.messages` carries no `turn_id`, so a reloaded conversation cannot be rated (#31865 item 1).

## Do

1. Declare the three route contracts (request, response, error codes) in `packages/spec`, read from the producer in cloud. Ask the `repo:cloud` seat by mailbox (`Request: cloud-confirm`) for any shape that cannot be read from cloud's code.
2. Add `turn_id` to `AIConversation.messages`.
3. Acceptance: the console and the client SDK can import the shapes; the `repo:cloud` seat confirms the producer answers them, or files the cloud-side alignment.

## Order

The client SDK methods card is `Blocked-by:` this card; #31889 and #31865 wait on both.
